text: Every city has an Odyssey. This is Oracle of Ithaca.
A living city model: thirty-eight infrastructure assets, sixty-nine dependency links, four districts, watched in real time.
Every incident has a name, an origin, and a blast radius, and the dashboard shows exactly what it touches downstream.
One failure. A graph decides the rest. A deterministic engine calculates how damage spreads, and when crews respond, the same graph runs in reverse, healing it block by block.
Athena explains what happened. The Oracle helps you decide what's next. Two Gemini powered advisors, grounded in the live city. Always counsel, never control.
Ithaca comes back online, not because the danger wasn't real, but because the choices were good. Oracle of Ithaca. A HackUTA submission.
